entries.subject: ESO eso1315a (Very Large Telescope FORS1)
entries.finding: The whole bright disc in B, V and R, 1964 px across, CC BY 4.0. The page's field (7.19 arcmin), centre and rotation (6.2 deg) do not match the Large JPEG; a blind star match to Gaia DR3 gives north up at 0.2000 arcsec per pixel, a 6.55 arcmin field, with 27 of 32 Gaia stars matched within 4 px.

entries.subject: Catalogues of NGC 1637's nebulae and clusters
entries.finding: Looked for on CDS on 2026-10-01: no HII-region, cluster or supernova-remnant table names NGC 1637, and it is not in the PHANGS-MUSE sample. The bank therefore has no dots.
entries.revisitWhen: A catalogue of its HII regions, clusters or remnants with sky positions is published.

entries.subject: Disc tilt and position angle
entries.finding: Leroy et al. (2021) give inclination 31.1 +/- 5.0 deg and position angle 20.6 +/- 10.0 deg. The galaxy is not in Lang et al.'s (2020) kinematic table or in THINGS, so no tighter measurement was found.
entries.revisitWhen: A kinematic fit with smaller errors is published.
